summary_method: Pool three held folds per seed/mask first, score each cell, average masks within training seed, then mean and sample SD over five training seeds.

primary_A_minus_B_B50.contrast: A minus B pooled held Macro-F1 under contiguous50; average masks within each seed first
primary_A_minus_B_B50.inference: Descriptive paired SD and sign count; no population CI or significance claim

secondary_block_minus_clean.status: Post-hoc descriptive interpretation only; not a replacement primary test

interpretation: A-B changes the covariance denominator and centering even on clean inputs; it does not isolate a loss-only intervention.
Both A and B have ideal covariance-congruence invariance. Support matching is not the origin of this invariance.
The network is a hybrid: branch algebra does not prove full-model or arbitrary-room invariance.
Different cohorts occupy different environments, so room effects are not causally isolated.
Sample SD is over five training seeds after mask averaging on fixed data; masks are not independent participants.
Historical target results were known during model development. These results remain exploratory; no universal superiority or novelty certificate.
